environment.description: Same CLI tool deployed in a hardened environment. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) and the RSA public key PEM file is mounted via a projected volume with subPath binding at /etc/service/keys/auth_public.pem. The PyJWT installation has been patched with a custom site-packages hook (jwt_policy.pth) that monkey-patches jwt.decode to inject an 'algorithms' allowlist override sourced from /run/secrets/jwt_allowed_algs (contents: RS256 only). The SECRET_SEED environment variable is injected via an init container that fetches from Vault with a 60-second TTL lease, and the pod's ServiceAccount has an OPA Gatekeeper constraint (K8sAllowedJWTAlgorithms) that validates at admission time that the JWT_ALLOWED_ALGORITHMS env var is set to 'RS256' — however this is an admission-time check only. The actual runtime enforcement comes from the .pth hook which intercepts all jwt.decode() calls and strips any algorithm not in the allowlist file before passing to the real decode function.

config.jwt_policy_pth_hook: patches jwt.decode to enforce algorithms from /run/secrets/jwt_allowed_algs
